            --font-mono: 'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* Sizes — all clamp() */
            --title-size: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 4.2rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3.2vw, 2.4rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.3vw, 1.05rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.62rem, 0.95vw, 0.82rem);
            --kpi-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem);
            --label-size: clamp(0.58rem, 0.85vw, 0.72rem);

            /* Spacing */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4.5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.8vw, 1.8rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration: 0.65s;
        }

        /* === RESET === */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* === VIEWPORT BASE (from viewport-base.css — mandatory) === */
        html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }
        html { scroll-snap-type: y mandatory; scroll-behavior: smooth; }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.1vw, 0.9rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.82rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
        /* === END VIEWPORT BASE === */

        /* === GLOBAL BASE === */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* === BACKGROUND PATTERNS === */
        .bg-dark {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
        }

        .bg-gradient-dark {
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 50%, rgba(37,99,235,0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
                        radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 20%, rgba(6,182,212,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                        var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .bg-gradient-amber {
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 80%, rgba(245,158,11,0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                        radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 20%, rgba(37,99,235,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                        var(--bg-primary);
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-cyan));
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* === NAV DOTS === */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            z-index: 999;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* === SLIDE HEADER STRIP === */
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6em;
            margin-bottom: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .slide-label::before {
            content: '';
            display: inline-block;
            width: 1.6em;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--accent-blue);
        }

        /* === ACCENT RULE === */
        .accent-rule {
            width: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-cyan));
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* === REVEAL ANIMATIONS === */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(28px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.93);
            transition: opacity var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal,
        .slide.visible .reveal-left,
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

        /* Staggered children */
        .stagger > *:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .stagger > *:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.65s; }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE COVER
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 0% 100%, rgba(37,99,235,0.18) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 0%, rgba(6,182,212,0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 60px 60px, 60px 60px;
        }

        .title-inner {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            height: 100%;
            max-width: min(900px, 90vw);
        }

        .title-tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
            background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: 0.3em 0.7em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            width: fit-content;
        }

        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            line-height: 1.05;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .title-main .highlight {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: 60ch;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 2.5vh, 2rem);
        }

        .title-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .title-stat {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }

        .title-stat .num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .title-stat .unit {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .title-divider {
            width: 1px;
            background: var(--border);
            align-self: stretch;
        }

        .source-badge {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(1rem, 2.5vh, 2rem);
            right: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 2 — GROWTH TRAJECTORY
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-growth {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .growth-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .growth-left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--element-gap); }

        .growth-timeline {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0;
        }

        .timeline-node {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            position: relative;
        }

        .timeline-line-wrap {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
        }

        .t-dot {
            width: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 14px);
            height: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 14px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .t-dot.filled { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .t-dot.large {
            width: clamp(14px, 2vw, 18px);
            height: clamp(14px, 2vw, 18px);
            border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px) rgba(6,182,212,0.4);
        }

        .t-connector {
            width: 2px;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: clamp(18px, 3vh, 36px);
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--accent-blue), rgba(37,99,235,0.3));
        }

        .t-content {
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .t-date {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 0.25em;
        }

        .t-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .t-title .big { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        .t-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.3em;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .growth-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .growth-arrow-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(380px, 90%);
        }

        .growth-from, .growth-to {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }

        .growth-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 5rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .growth-from .growth-num { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .growth-to .growth-num { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        .growth-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .growth-arrow {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.3em;
            color: var(--accent-amber);
        }

        .growth-arrow-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .growth-multiplier {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
        }

        .growth-months {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .growth-new-badge {
            background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12);
            border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: 0.35em 0.8em;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        @media (max-width: 720px) {
            .growth-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 3 — TAXONOMY MATRIX
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-taxonomy {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .taxonomy-layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .taxonomy-header {
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .matrix-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .matrix-agent-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(100px, 18vw, 180px) repeat(6, 1fr);
            gap: 3px;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .matrix-agent-header {
            background: transparent;
        }

        .agent-label {
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }

        .agent-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.8vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.8vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: block;
        }

        .agent-customer .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .agent-employee .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .agent-creative .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .agent-code .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .agent-data .agent-dot { background: #a78bfa; }
        .agent-security .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .agent-customer { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .agent-employee { color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .agent-creative { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .agent-code { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .agent-data { color: #a78bfa; }
        .agent-security { color: var(--accent-red); }

        .matrix-rows {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
        }

        .matrix-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(100px, 18vw, 180px) repeat(6, 1fr);
            gap: 3px;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .matrix-industry {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vw, 0.55rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .matrix-cell {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: background 0.2s ease;
        }

        .matrix-cell::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
        }

        .matrix-cell.c { background: rgba(6,182,212,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(6,182,212,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.e { background: rgba(37,99,235,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.cr { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.co { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.d { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.s { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.empty { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px solid transparent; }

        .cell-dot {
            width: clamp(4px, 0.65vw, 7px);
            height: clamp(4px, 0.65vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .c .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .e .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .cr .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .co .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .d .cell-dot { background: #a78bfa; }
        .s .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .matrix-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 4 — AUTOMOTIVE DEEP DIVE TABLE
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-auto {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 10%, rgba(245,158,11,0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                              linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px),
                              linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 60px 60px, 60px 60px;
        }

        .auto-layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .auto-header { flex-shrink: 0; }

        .use-case-table {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .table-head {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(60px, 9vw, 90px) clamp(80px, 12vw, 120px) 1fr clamp(100px, 18vw, 200px);
            gap: 3px;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            padding: 0.4em 0.6em;
        }

        .table-body {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
        }

        .table-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(60px, 9vw, 90px) clamp(80px, 12vw, 120px) 1fr clamp(100px, 18vw, 200px);
            gap: 3px;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .td {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .td-agent {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .td-customer { color: var(--accent-cyan); background: rgba(6,182,212,0.08); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan); }
        .td-employee { color: var(--accent-blue); background: rgba(37,99,235,0.08); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-blue); }
        .td-code { color: var(--accent-green); background: rgba(16,185,129,0.08); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-green); }

        .td-company { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }

            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            gap: var(--element-gap);

            flex: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .kpi-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.8rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .kpi-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
        }

        .kpi-card.gold::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-amber), #fcd34d); }
        .kpi-card.green::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-green), #34d399); }
        .kpi-card.blue::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-cyan)); }
        .kpi-card.red::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, var(--accent-amber)); }

        .kpi-top { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.15em; }

        .kpi-org {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .kpi-metric {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--kpi-size);
            line-height: 0.95;
        }

        .kpi-card.gold .kpi-metric { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .kpi-card.green .kpi-metric { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .kpi-card.blue .kpi-metric { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .kpi-card.red .kpi-metric { color: #fb923c; }

        .kpi-bottom { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.2em; }

        .kpi-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.25;

            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .kpi-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12);
            border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.25);
            border-radius: 2px;

            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            width: fit-content;
            margin-top: 0.3em;

           SLIDE 6 — CROSS-INDUSTRY PATTERNS

            background: var(--bg-primary);

            flex-direction: column;

            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

            overflow: hidden;

            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);

            position: relative;

            border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;

<script>
    /* ============================================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles: scroll-snap nav, keyboard, touch, progress bar, dots
       ============================================================ */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupScrollProgress();
        }

        /* --- Build nav dots --- */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.classList.add('nav-dot');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                if (i === 0) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        /* --- Intersection observer: add .visible, update active dot + progress --- */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const opts = { threshold: 0.55 };
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        this.currentIndex = idx;
                        this.updateDots(idx);
                        this.updateProgress(idx);
                    }
                });
            }, opts);

            this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
        }

        updateDots(idx) {
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
        }

        updateProgress(idx) {
            const pct = ((idx) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            this.progressBar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(pct));
        }

        /* --- Navigate to slide by index --- */
        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* --- Keyboard navigation --- */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / swipe navigation --- */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let touchStartY = 0;
            let touchStartX = 0;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                    this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Update progress bar on scroll --- */
        setupScrollProgress() {
            window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
                const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
                const pct = docHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / docHeight) * 100 : 0;
                this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            }, { passive: true });
        }
    }

    new SlidePresentation();
</script>
</body>
</html>

            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: 60ch;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 2.5vh, 2rem);
        }

        .title-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .title-stat {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }

        .title-stat .num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .title-stat .unit {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .title-divider {
            width: 1px;
            background: var(--border);
            align-self: stretch;
        }

        .source-badge {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(1rem, 2.5vh, 2rem);
            right: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 2 — GROWTH TRAJECTORY
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-growth {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .growth-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .growth-left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--element-gap); }

        .growth-timeline {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0;
        }

        .timeline-node {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            position: relative;
        }

        .timeline-line-wrap {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
        }

        .t-dot {
            width: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 14px);
            height: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 14px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .t-dot.filled { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .t-dot.large {
            width: clamp(14px, 2vw, 18px);
            height: clamp(14px, 2vw, 18px);
            border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px) rgba(6,182,212,0.4);
        }

        .t-connector {
            width: 2px;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: clamp(18px, 3vh, 36px);
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--accent-blue), rgba(37,99,235,0.3));
        }

        .t-content {
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .t-date {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 0.25em;
        }

        .t-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .t-title .big { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        .t-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.3em;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .growth-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .growth-arrow-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(380px, 90%);
        }

        .growth-from, .growth-to {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }

        .growth-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 5rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .growth-from .growth-num { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .growth-to .growth-num { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        .growth-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .growth-arrow {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.3em;
            color: var(--accent-amber);
        }

        .growth-arrow-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .growth-multiplier {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
        }

        .growth-months {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .growth-new-badge {
            background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12);
            border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.3);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: 0.35em 0.8em;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        @media (max-width: 720px) {
            .growth-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 3 — TAXONOMY MATRIX
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-taxonomy {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .taxonomy-layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .taxonomy-header {
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .matrix-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .matrix-agent-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(100px, 18vw, 180px) repeat(6, 1fr);
            gap: 3px;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .matrix-agent-header {
            background: transparent;
        }

        .agent-label {
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }

        .agent-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.8vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.8vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: block;
        }

        .agent-customer .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .agent-employee .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .agent-creative .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .agent-code .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .agent-data .agent-dot { background: #a78bfa; }
        .agent-security .agent-dot { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .agent-customer { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .agent-employee { color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .agent-creative { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .agent-code { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .agent-data { color: #a78bfa; }
        .agent-security { color: var(--accent-red); }

        .matrix-rows {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
        }

        .matrix-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(100px, 18vw, 180px) repeat(6, 1fr);
            gap: 3px;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .matrix-industry {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vw, 0.55rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .matrix-cell {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: background 0.2s ease;
        }

        .matrix-cell::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
        }

        .matrix-cell.c { background: rgba(6,182,212,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(6,182,212,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.e { background: rgba(37,99,235,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.cr { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.co { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.d { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.s { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2); }
        .matrix-cell.empty { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px solid transparent; }

        .cell-dot {
            width: clamp(4px, 0.65vw, 7px);
            height: clamp(4px, 0.65vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .c .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .e .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .cr .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .co .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-green); }
        .d .cell-dot { background: #a78bfa; }
        .s .cell-dot { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .matrix-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 4 — AUTOMOTIVE DEEP DIVE TABLE
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-auto {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 10%, rgba(245,158,11,0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                              linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px),
                              linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 60px 60px, 60px 60px;
        }

        .auto-layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .auto-header { flex-shrink: 0; }

        .use-case-table {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .table-head {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(60px, 9vw, 90px) clamp(80px, 12vw, 120px) 1fr clamp(100px, 18vw, 200px);
            gap: 3px;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            padding: 0.4em 0.6em;
        }

        .table-body {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
        }

        .table-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(60px, 9vw, 90px) clamp(80px, 12vw, 120px) 1fr clamp(100px, 18vw, 200px);
            gap: 3px;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .td {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .td-agent {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .td-customer { color: var(--accent-cyan); background: rgba(6,182,212,0.08); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan); }
        .td-employee { color: var(--accent-blue); background: rgba(37,99,235,0.08); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-blue); }
        .td-code { color: var(--accent-green); background: rgba(16,185,129,0.08); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-green); }

        .td-company { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
        .td-metric { font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .td-metric.green { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .td-metric.cyan { color: var(--accent-cyan); }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 5 — KPI ROI HIGHLIGHTS
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-roi {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(245,158,11,0.06) 0%, transparent 60%),
                              linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px),
                              linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 60px 60px, 60px 60px;
        }

        .roi-layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .roi-header { flex-shrink: 0; }

        .kpi-grid {
            flex: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .kpi-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.8vw, 1.8rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .kpi-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
        }

        .kpi-card.gold::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-amber), #fcd34d); }
        .kpi-card.green::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-green), #34d399); }
        .kpi-card.blue::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-cyan)); }
        .kpi-card.red::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, var(--accent-amber)); }

        .kpi-top { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.15em; }

        .kpi-org {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .kpi-metric {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--kpi-size);
            line-height: 0.95;
        }

        .kpi-card.gold .kpi-metric { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .kpi-card.green .kpi-metric { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .kpi-card.blue .kpi-metric { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .kpi-card.red .kpi-metric { color: #fb923c; }

        .kpi-bottom { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.2em; }

        .kpi-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }

        .kpi-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .kpi-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12);
            border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.25);
            border-radius: 2px;
            padding: 0.15em 0.5em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            width: fit-content;
            margin-top: 0.3em;
        }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 6 — CROSS-INDUSTRY PATTERNS
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-patterns {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .patterns-layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .patterns-header { flex-shrink: 0; }

        .patterns-grid {
            flex: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pattern-col {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .pattern-col::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
        }

        .pattern-col.col-cyan::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), rgba(6,182,212,0.2)); }
        .pattern-col.col-blue::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), rgba(37,99,235,0.2)); }
        .pattern-col.col-amber::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-amber), rgba(245,158,11,0.2)); }

        .pattern-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .pattern-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .col-cyan .pattern-title { color: var(--accent-cyan); }
        .col-blue .pattern-title { color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .col-amber .pattern-title { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        .pattern-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .pattern-companies {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3em;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .company-chip {
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-radius: 3px;
            padding: 0.3em 0.6em;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .company-chip strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .pattern-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding: 0.25em 0.5em;
            border-radius: 2px;
            width: fit-content;
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }

        .col-cyan .pattern-tag { background: rgba(6,182,212,0.1); color: var(--accent-cyan); border: 1px solid rgba(6,182,212,0.2); }
        .col-blue .pattern-tag { background: rgba(37,99,235,0.1); color: #93c5fd; border: 1px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.2); }
        .col-amber .pattern-tag { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.1); color: var(--accent-amber); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.2); }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .patterns-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* ============================================================
           SLIDE 7 — STRATEGIC TAKEAWAYS
           ============================================================ */
        .slide-takeaways {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 100%, rgba(37,99,235,0.12) 0%, transparent 50%),
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.012) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 60px 60px, 60px 60px;
        }

        .takeaways-layout {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .takeaways-header { flex-shrink: 0; }

        .takeaways-grid {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .takeaway-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .takeaway-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        .takeaway-body { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.2em; }

        .takeaway-heading {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .takeaway-text {

<script>
    /* ============================================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles: scroll-snap nav, keyboard, touch, progress bar, dots
       ============================================================ */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupScrollProgress();
        }

        /* --- Build nav dots --- */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.classList.add('nav-dot');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                if (i === 0) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        /* --- Intersection observer: add .visible, update active dot + progress --- */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const opts = { threshold: 0.55 };
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        this.currentIndex = idx;
                        this.updateDots(idx);
                        this.updateProgress(idx);
                    }
                });
            }, opts);

            this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
        }

        updateDots(idx) {
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
        }

        updateProgress(idx) {
            const pct = ((idx) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            this.progressBar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(pct));
        }

        /* --- Navigate to slide by index --- */
        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* --- Keyboard navigation --- */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / swipe navigation --- */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let touchStartY = 0;
            let touchStartX = 0;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                    this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Update progress bar on scroll --- */
        setupScrollProgress() {
            window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
                const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
                const pct = docHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / docHeight) * 100 : 0;
                this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            }, { passive: true });
        }
    }

    new SlidePresentation();
</script>

<script>
    /* ============================================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Handles: scroll-snap nav, keyboard, touch, progress bar, dots
       ============================================================ */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentIndex = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            this.buildNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupScrollProgress();
        }

        /* --- Build nav dots --- */
        buildNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.classList.add('nav-dot');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                if (i === 0) btn.classList.add('active');
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        /* --- Intersection observer: add .visible, update active dot + progress --- */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const opts = { threshold: 0.55 };
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        this.currentIndex = idx;
                        this.updateDots(idx);
                        this.updateProgress(idx);
                    }
                });
            }, opts);

            this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
        }

        updateDots(idx) {
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
        }

        updateProgress(idx) {
            const pct = ((idx) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            this.progressBar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(pct));
        }

        /* --- Navigate to slide by index --- */
        goTo(idx) {
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        /* --- Keyboard navigation --- */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / swipe navigation --- */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let touchStartY = 0;
            let touchStartX = 0;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                    this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.currentIndex + 1 : this.currentIndex - 1);
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Update progress bar on scroll --- */
        setupScrollProgress() {
            window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
                const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
                const pct = docHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / docHeight) * 100 : 0;
                this.progressBar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
            }, { passive: true });
        }
    }

    new SlidePresentation();
</script>
